label: C
design_name: Rounded Notebook C with two through-vented outward-cone hinges
status: Final marked, rounded meshes exported and digitally verified. Physical print and release are untested.
changes_from_single_coupon_C: Two complete copies of C’s opposing outward cones and vented stationary cheeks share an axis, with 34 mm between station centers.
Both inboard cheek vents open to the 6 mm gap between stations. The cheek ends were shortened by 2 mm to fit the notebook layout.
Each pair of hinge stations is integral to a single 2.8 mm panel. The moving panel starts 11.8 mm from the axis in X so it swings past the fixed cheeks. Rotor tabs meet it with a one-layer shoulder.
Free panel edges align when closed. Open interior of the fixed panel carries the engraved model, creation date and C mark.

marking.surface: Fixed left panel interior, top-facing in print pose
marking.treatment: Debossed with a flat floor and open above
marking.text_font: Arial Bold with 0.06 mm outward offset per edge
marking.font_required_for_source_regeneration: Arial Bold. Marks are baked into the supplied STLs.

clearances.definitions: Cone normal and matching cross-section radial offsets refer to ideal 45-degree surfaces. Face and seam gaps are per side. Engagement is tip extension past the inner cheek face.

fold.convention: Right-hand rule about positive Y. Zero is the assembled print pose. Negative angles lift the right flap above the left flap.
fold.source_preview: Set fold from 0 to 180. This parameter is the positive lift magnitude.

print_assumptions.supports: Off. The 45-degree cone surfaces are self-supporting in the intended layer direction. The socket vent leaves a local roof span up to 1.30 mm.
print_assumptions.adhesion: Both flaps contact the plate in the supplied pose. Keep brim and support material out of the seams and bearing gaps.
print_assumptions.assembly: Print the assembled STL flat with both shells in the supplied position. Both units are already nested and captive. Normal clearance release after cooling is the first motion.

mesh_and_kinematic_checks.continuous_centered_fold: In the printed coordinate frame the lowest moving panel radius stays outside the highest fixed cheek radius. The fixed plate is outside the lower-left sweep of the moving rotor. Separate Y bands prevent cross-station interference. Faceted cones stay radially inside their matching sockets throughout rotation.
mesh_and_kinematic_checks.retention: Digital axial shifts of ±0.64 mm cleared. Both directions intersected shoulders by ±0.66 mm. Each opposite cone retains a nominal 1.85 mm axial engagement at shoulder contact.
mesh_and_kinematic_checks.first_layer_gap_order: Station at Y=-17 mm, low and high Y seam. Then station at Y=+17 mm, low and high Y seam.
mesh_and_kinematic_checks.outer_edge_section_check: Both free cover edges remained at their 39 mm plan limit at Z=0.20 mm and tapered inward by about 0.73 mm at Z=2.79 mm.

limitations: PLA flow and first-layer spread can reduce clearances. Parts spanning both hinges may be sensitive to warp and axis misalignment.
Physical release, engraving readability in printed PLA, vent bridging, strength, fatigue and all-path tilted extraction were not tested.
The digital check uses an ideal rigid concentric motion. No hard stop or detent is integrated.
No slicer toolpath or printer operation was run.

rounding.functional_edges: Bottom outlines retain a flat sole and vertical skirts. Both cone interfaces, socket and vent bores, axial shoulders and first-layer seam relief retain their working profiles.
rounding.support_approach: Upper edge radii taper inward toward the top. Plan radii are extruded up from the plate. No underside edge roll was added.
